hypothesis: An affine correction of frozen GBCT output coordinates can repair errors with less damage when supervised by acceptable intervals rather than exact targets.
evidence: Input-cell diagnostic found no incompatible paired output intervals in32 constructed local pairs; not a global precision proof.
Nonlinear hidden-feature corrections and input-affine asinh corrections failed transfer. Original-GBCT-coordinate affine feasibility is a distinct function class and objective.
model: Frozen800-dimensional final hidden activation, training-only standardization, zero FP32 affine58-output head. Add head output times fixed per-species scale to original normalizedGBCT coordinates inFP64. Same base input/output preprocessing and decoder. No inference reference or clipping beyond the already declared GBCT inverse-domain rule.
scaling: Percomponent width is half of the finite normalizedGBCT encodings of max(-Y,d-tau) and d+tau. Floor at128*eps64*max(1,abs(endpoints)), report counts. Median width across common50k defines each species head-output scale. Lower acceptance preimage remains -infinity when d-tau<=-Y; finite endpoint used only for scaling. Hidden standard deviation zero ->1, report count.
objective: point: SmoothL1(beta1) of (predicted_coordinate-exact_target)/component_width; interval: SmoothL1(beta1) of distance(predicted_coordinate,acceptable_interval)/same_width. Only target set changes. Fixed bases/features/rows/seed batches/scales/Adam cosine schedule, zero initialization. No preservation penalty, weight decay, clipping, routing or checkpoint selection. Final6000 update only.
exposure: Reuse exact prior common50k excluding unionbothU/headfitIDs. Both bases and their preprocessing saw broader training pool. FullU20k andD1023 are development diagnostics, not independent confirmation.
prechecks: Exact zero-head anchor replay, species alignment, reference endpoints valid, widths finite positive, interval membership versus direct physical rule, paired parameter/init counts, source/evaluator hashes and Bubblewrap boundary.
evaluation: All unchanged campaign gates, both seeds/fullpopulations; independent physical recount, saved-model state-only replay, raw timing, domain corrections and finite outputs. Ideal fixed-feature objective convex does not imply FP32/Adam reaches its optimum.

outcomes.interval_beats_point_and_anchor: Check every gate; pending authorized promotion only, then robustness.
outcomes.interval_reduces_damage_but_no_gain: No promotion; inspect fixed-feature feasibility and optimization before further variants.
outcomes.both_fail: Close this recipe; do not claim interval learning or frozen features impossible.
